operators.O: other_explicit: O3[F](t;w)=F'(t)/(1 - w*F'(t)), evaluated at t=w*z+x

hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: With A=w*z+x and F(t)=tanh(t): G0001 is O1[F](A)=F(A)-z; G0002 is O2[F](A)=F'(A)=1/cosh(A)^2; G0003 is O3[F](A)=F'(A)/(1 - w*F'(A))=1/(cosh(A)^2 - w).
proof_obligations: G0003 - F'(w*z+x)/(1 - w*F'(w*z+x)) = 0 under cosh(w*z+x)^2 != w
hypotheses.rationale: The three catalog expressions share the argument A=w*z+x and are related through F=tanh: G0001 is the residual F(A)-z, G0002 is the derivative F'(A), and G0003 is the implicit-function derivative F'(A)/(1-w*F'(A)).
